text: Das Spiel startete schnell: Viktor Quinlan traf gleich zweimal für Kingsmoor FC, einmal per Elfmeter und einmal nach einem schönen Pass von Felix Duarte. Seine Chancen waren sehr gut, mit xG-Werten von 0,76 und 0,2 - das heißt, er hätte diese Chancen mit hoher Wahrscheinlichkeit verwandelt [#152] [#222]. Westport Albion antwortete mit zwei Toren von Rafael Delacroix, der top Chancen nutzte, besonders eine mit xG fast 1, also fast sicher verwertbar [#401] [#553]. Kenji Rahman glich für Albion aus, bevor Luca Iversen nach einem schnellen Pass von Mason Morales kurz vor Schluss den Ausgleich für Kingsmoor erzielte [#983] [#1516]. Trotz einer roten Karte gegen Felix Barros blieb es spannend. Kingsmoor setzte auf Flanken, Westport auf direkten Spielstil – beide gaben alles bis zum Ende. Ein echtes Spektakel für alle Fans! [#1495] [#1187] [#1459]

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in de

- Kingsmoor FC's first penalty goal by Viktor Quinlan at 8' was won via a direct set piece opportunity (penalty), reflecting a moment of pressing or forcing errors by Westport Albion inside their box, likely from a defensive mistake against Kingsmoor's 4-4-2 wide formation press [152].
- The second Kingsmoor FC goal at 12' originated from a build-up of 8 passes over 26.7 seconds starting from a regain, showing a structured, patient overload on the wide areas typical for their 4-4-2 wide crossing style, involving multiple midfield combinations before Felix Duarte assisted Quinlan who scored close in [222].
- Westport Albion's two quick goals at 22’ and 30’ came from regains leading to vertical intricate passing sequences (7 and 10 passes respectively), underlining their direct and vertical style from a 4-4-2; especially the 30’ goal involved a cross from Dylan Rahman to Rafael Delacroix, highlighting their vertical passing combined with wide crosses [401,553].
- Kingsmoor's late equalizer (82') from Luca Iversen followed a quick, short 2-pass build-up from a ball regain, with Mason Morales delivering a cross, emphasizing Kingsmoor’s reliance on wide crossing and swift counter-attacks after turnovers, especially effective when Westport was dropped deeper defending a narrow lead [1516].
- Tactical shifts influenced these patterns: Kingsmoor increased pressing and directness after 65’, indicating a late-game push to overload and force turnovers in Westport's half, while Westport dropped deeper and slowed tempo from 79’, adopting a lower block to protect their lead, which allowed Kingsmoor more possession and crossing chances leading to their equalizer [1187,1459].

- Viktor Quinlan scored 2 goals with a combined xG of 0.957, including a penalty at 8' and a goal assisted by Felix Duarte at 12' [#152, #222].
- Rafael Delacroix scored twice for Westport Albion with very high xG values of 0.797 and 0.992 at 22' and 30', indicating strong finishing [#401, #553].
- Kenji Rahman scored the equalizer for Westport Albion at 51' with an xG of 0.449 from open play [#983].
- Luca Iversen scored Kingsmoor FC's last goal at 82' with an xG of 0.854 assisted by Mason Morales to level the match 3-3 [#1516].
- Felix Barros received a second yellow card (red card) at 81', affecting Kingsmoor FC late in the match [#1495].
